A12Analogue

Clock Divider

Divide and multiply a clock

Derives four more clocks from one: slower as a divider, faster as a multiplier. Sequencers, envelopes and effects then run in fixed ratios.

  • Ratios of 2, 3, 4 and 8
  • MULT / DIV switch
  • Reset input
